# Cuoco

> A recipe app for iPhone with a voice assistant for cooking. It also connects to Claude and ChatGPT.

Cuoco is a mobile app for saving recipes, planning meals, building a shopping list and cooking with a voice assistant that answers questions as you go. It is developed by Mark Berry, a sole trader based in the United Kingdom.

## Availability

- iPhone: available now on the App Store — https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6766098644
- Android: not available yet. A waitlist is open at https://get-cuoco.app/#download

## Key features

- **Voice assistant (Ask Cuoco)** — press the Ask Cuoco button and speak to find recipes, add to the meal plan or shopping list, and edit recipes. In Cook Mode it answers questions about the current step, sets timers, suggests substitutes and does kitchen maths, and replies out loud.
- **Hey Cuoco wake word** — optional. When the user switches it on, in Cook Mode, on iOS 26 or later, they can say "Hey Cuoco" and ask hands-free. Everywhere else the assistant is press-to-talk.
- **Works with Claude and ChatGPT** — users can connect Cuoco to Claude or ChatGPT as a custom connector (address: https://mcp.get-cuoco.app/mcp). The assistant can then search, read, save and edit recipes; manage collections and favourites; read and change the meal plan; and read and change the shopping list. It asks before each change. It cannot delete recipes or collections, clear the whole meal plan or shopping list at once, or change the account or subscription. Recipe edits made this way cannot be undone. Setup steps: https://get-cuoco.app/connect
- **Recipe import** — from a web link, a photo (including recipes spread over several photos), pasted text or TikTok, or by sharing into Cuoco from another app.
- **Automatic recipe details** — nutrition, cuisine, meal type and allergens are added for you.
- **Shopping list** — add a recipe's ingredients in one tap; items are sorted into categories and duplicates can be combined.
- **Meal planner** — plan recipes by day, week or month.
- **Collections** — group and organise saved recipes.
- **Cook Mode** — one step at a time, with timers and step read-aloud.

## Pricing

- Free 7-day trial of every feature, no card required
- Cuoco Pro: £2.99 a month — suits most people
- Cuoco Premium: £4.99 a month — for heavy voice users
- Pro and Premium have the same features. The only difference is the monthly AI allowance, which is 150% higher on Premium.
- Subscriptions are billed through the Apple App Store.
